rule: These directives encode the latest explicit user instruction and supersede older PR descriptions, comments, tests, scheduler summaries and inferred policy whenever they conflict. Autonomous research, remediation, promotion and integration workflows may enforce but may not redefine this file.

paper_v7_authorization.interpretation: 100% is a hard ceiling, not a target. Kelly, available sleeve cash, executable depth, authoritative fees, slippage, adverse markout, uncertainty/capital-time economics, state integrity and the 15% drawdown kill switch still bind.

architecture.target: one unified V7 PAPER engine on main

legacy_retirement.before_gate: V3/V4/V5/V6 are compatibility or migration sources only. Do not create new legacy production architecture; migrate useful contracts, evidence and runtime primitives into V7/common code.
legacy_retirement.after_gate: Stop legacy research/runtime schedulers and remove superseded V3/V4/V5/V6 entrypoints, configs, adapters, tests, workflows, dashboards and obsolete research branches. Any remaining v6_* dependency required by V7 must first be renamed/migrated into a canonical V7/common primitive.

model_contracts.pca: single-leg residual statistical arbitrage only; evaluate 30m, 1h, 2h and 6h separately; no mandatory hedge basket, terminal-probability semantics or binary Kelly
model_contracts.local_factor: leave-targets-out orientation-invariant factor basis, null-preserving inference, dependence-robust multiplicity, fresh completed regular history at decision time, phi^h forecast and PnL-unit hedge ratios; evaluate 30m and 60m separately
model_contracts.cross_sectional_ranking: relative top-vs-bottom executable ranking; evaluate 30m, 1h, 2h and 6h separately; do not pool inference across horizons
model_contracts.micro_maker: optimize fill-conditioned net PnL, not fill probability; queue, OFI, imbalance, microprice, depth, toxicity and adverse markout are required; exits/markouts are quantity-specific depth-aware
model_contracts.micro_taker: complete executable round-trip target with entry ask VWAP, expected/realized exit bid VWAP, both authoritative fees, slippage, uncertainty, adverse markout and capital-time costs
model_contracts.graph_rv: prospective dual-clock joint-state evidence only; no product/minimum of marginal fill probabilities; explicit partial-state unwind; fixed-horizon executable liquidation for full and partial states; dependence-robust chronological inference
model_contracts.external_intelligence: fail closed; raw external features never become a synthetic terminal probability without approved probability mapping and evidence

rules: keep state, PnL, labels and inference separate by frequency
do not select a new frequency post hoc on the same holdout
new frequencies require prospective chronological evidence

current_priority_order: Preserve the current V7 PAPER authorization: no binding fixed-dollar trade cap, 100% trade/market/event/gross hard ceilings, Kelly <=25%, drawdown <=15%, PAPER-only and authenticated execution disabled.
Make the single unified V7 research head deterministic-green and eliminate stale policy/governance copies rather than creating parallel V7 branches.
Validate and integrate Graph/RV v3 executable dependence-robust admission and runtime process-group draining / single-writer ownership into V7/common primitives.
Keep the HF event-time/depth-aware maker, causal-flow/depth-aware taker and hard-arb freshness successors on the current V7 authorization without weakening executable economics.
Repair Local Factor temporal freshness so a stale fitted residual state can never be combined with a current executable book; preserve target-excluded PC1, conditional null bootstrap, IUT and BY.

Run PCA, Local Factor, cross-sectional ranking, Micro Maker, Micro Taker, Graph/RV, hard arb and External Intelligence as one V7 structure, with state/PnL/inference separated by predeclared frequency and horizon.
Run the exact-green V7 candidate continuously in isolated PAPER evidence mode without mutating the incumbent champion until integration gates are satisfied.
Create one fresh integration branch from current main with exact source SHA/provenance; merge only after deterministic, governance, executable-economic and data-health gates are satisfied.
Run exact-SHA CI, monitoring, live-paper, private single-writer, deploy and server-health validation; advance paper-validated and deploy the identical V7 SHA.

Once the machine legacy-retirement gate is true, stop compatibility schedulers and remove all superseded V3/V4/V5/V6 code, adapters, workflows, tests, configs, dashboards and obsolete branches, leaving only canonical V7/common primitives.

scheduler_assignments.administrator-supervisor: Treat convergence to one V7 system and post-health legacy retirement as project-level invariants. Report any scheduler or PR that recreates legacy production architecture, duplicates runtime ownership, conflicts with current V7 authorization or delays eligible retirement.
scheduler_assignments.research-policy: Treat this file as current operator authorization. Enforce the current 100%/no-fixed-cap V7 PAPER authorization, one-ledger/one-owner architecture, exact provenance and PAPER-only/authenticated-disabled separation; forbid legacy expansion and cleanup before the retirement gate.
scheduler_assignments.research-queue: Prioritize V7 deterministic blockers, Local Factor freshness, Graph/runtime execution evidence, multi-frequency V7 model evidence and external intelligence. Before the retirement gate, V6 work is migration-only; after the gate, stop launching V6 research and route work to canonical legacy retirement until clean.
scheduler_assignments.promotion-controller: Do not treat the authorized V7 100% PAPER ceilings as a safety-policy violation. Promote only exact-source V7 integrations with green technical/governance gates and executable OOS economics where applicable; single writer/broker/ledger and same-SHA validation remain hard requirements.
scheduler_assignments.integration-merge: Merge only the single canonical V7 integration. Refuse bounded-policy rollback PRs, duplicate runtime owners, stale model copies, legacy expansion and cleanup-before-health candidates.
scheduler_assignments.control-plane-event-bridge: Dispatch only the existing Promotion Controller after validator completion and Integration Merge after successful controller completion. Never merge, deploy, mutate paper-validated, reinterpret operator directives, change model policy or execute orders directly.
scheduler_assignments.post-merge-validation: Bind code, monitoring and live-paper validation to the exact merged V7 SHA and preserve the same-SHA chain required before the legacy-retirement gate can become true.
scheduler_assignments.code-validation: Enforce current V7 authorization, deterministic V7 model contracts, single-owner runtime contracts, scheduler completeness and legacy-retirement ordering in Release and Debug.
scheduler_assignments.monitoring-validation: Validate V7 per-strategy/per-frequency PnL, fills, markouts, queue/depth, process ownership, exact deployed revision and the machine inputs used by the legacy-retirement gate.
scheduler_assignments.live-paper-validation: Validate the exact unified V7 candidate using public data; do not require arbitrary trade count by weakening executable economics; advance paper-validated only on exact-SHA success.
scheduler_assignments.paper-server-deploy: Deploy only the exact paper-validated V7 revision and preserve PAPER-only/authenticated-disabled separation; deployment verification must support champion version 7 before V7 promotion.
scheduler_assignments.paper-server-health: Verify exact deployed V7 SHA, single writer/process ownership, recorder, broker, proxy, Grafana/metrics, risk and data freshness. A successful exact-SHA V7 health result is required for legacy retirement.
scheduler_assignments.forward-maker-research: Continue prospective V7 maker evidence across HF cadences with fill-conditioned PnL and bounded-delay quantity-specific depth-aware markouts; do not optimize fill count alone.
scheduler_assignments.v6-live-data-research: Compatibility/migration evidence only until the V7 retirement gate. Do not create new V6 architecture or promotion paths. After the gate, retire this scheduler rather than extending it.
scheduler_assignments.alpha-factory: Rank V7 challengers by executable OOS economics and incremental utility, using chronology-safe independent evidence. Do not propose legacy expansion or obsolete bounded-policy rollback as alpha work.
scheduler_assignments.meta-supervisor: Drive the current priority order toward one V7 system. Compute the retirement gate from exact refs/deploy/health; before the gate coordinate V7 migration/validation, after the gate switch the control plane to legacy-retirement mode and redispatch cleanup until legacy surfaces are gone.
scheduler_assignments.fast-arb-shadow-research: Test V7 hard/fast-arbitrage evidence across HF cadences with strict receive/exchange freshness, depth, verified fees, legging latency and unwind accounting.
scheduler_assignments.arb-theory-research: Derive Graph/structural V7 opportunities under the prospective joint-state fixed-horizon execution contract, never marginal-fill products or assumed terminal payout floors.
scheduler_assignments.external-intelligence: Collect, persist and chronologically validate public external information for V7; publish research evidence only and keep probability mapping fail-closed.
scheduler_assignments.live-api-smoke: Read-only Gamma/CLOB connectivity and freshness only; no policy/state mutation.
scheduler_assignments.v7-cross-sectional-ranking-research: Run scheduled relative cross-sectional ranking research on frozen point-in-time data with chronological holdouts and separate horizon inference; publish research-only evidence and never mutate champion, paper-validated, deployment, capital or authenticated execution.
scheduler_assignments.v7-point-in-time-universe-archive: Archive the exact paper-validated public universe every 30 minutes into immutable point-in-time snapshots for causal V7 PCA, Local Factor and ranking research; remain read-only with respect to champion, execution, PnL and risk state.
scheduler_assignments.v7-unified-paper-evidence: Continuously reconcile only an exact-green final V7 research head into an isolated per-SHA PAPER runtime; never merge/deploy, never mutate champion or paper-validated, and never enable authenticated execution; collect machine-readable evidence only.
scheduler_assignments.v6-market-cache-relay: Compatibility data relay only until the V7 retirement gate. Do not mutate V7 model policy/champion or create new V6 state. After the gate, migrate any still-required cache primitive to V7/common naming and retire this scheduler.

forbidden_regressions: Do not reopen, recreate or merge a V7 policy whose purpose is to restore a $125 fixed trade cap or 5%/15%/70% market/event/gross caps as current authorization.
Do not use PR #513, #516, #519, #537 or #547, or an equivalent bounded-policy successor, as V7 integration/governance source.
Do not delete legacy code before the unified V7 SHA is merged to main, exact-SHA validated, advanced to paper-validated, deployed as that same SHA and server-health green.
Do not keep V3/V4/V5/V6 production architecture or compatibility schedulers after the legacy-retirement gate is satisfied; migrate required primitives and retire them.
Do not add authenticated or real-money execution.
Do not create a second live state writer, broker owner or execution ledger.
Do not write scheduler-generated code or artifacts outside this repository except the existing private PAPER runtime/deployment/telemetry channels explicitly registered by the control plane.
